entities.summary: The Kingdom of Powo or sPo bo was a kingdom founded in the 13th century, located in present-day Bomê County, Tibet. The monarchs of Powo were descendants of Drigum Tsenpo, and used the title Kanam Gyalpo or Kanam Depa.
